sloka: मनःशिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः ।त्वया प्रनष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि ।। ५.४०.५।।।।
transliteration: manaḥśilāyāstilako gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ ।tvayā pranaṣṭe tilake taṁ kila smartumarhasi ।। 5.40.5।।।।

translations.english: '(Further remind him), 'When my tilaka mark was erased, you painted tilaka with a stone (manassita pigment) nearby. O Rama you should remember that (incident).
